preconditions.description: The string length does not exceed 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The string consists of lowercase Latin letters and digits.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum((stdin.count(c) * (stdin.count(c) + 1)) // 2 for c in set(stdin))
postconditions.description: The output is the number of ordered pairs (i, j) such that S[i] = S[j].
